body:
## Owner-approved user feedback
Food rows have too much text. Remove confidence score, manual/source label and verify action from every food row. Remove the entire Needs Review section; users inspect/correct by tapping the individual food card. This is implementation-approved UX refinement, not a change to nutrition evidence or data.

## Grounding
TodayLogViews.swift MealItemRow renders ProvenanceLabel, ConfidenceBox and VerifyActionLabel; NeedsReviewSection duplicates food names, confidence and notes. Views.swift mounts the section. MealItemEditSheet.swift already exposes provenance; extend/reuse this detail surface rather than creating a second review workflow.

## Acceptance criteria
- Today and expanded History/day food rows retain illustration (coordinate #223), name, portion, macros, kcal and full-row accessible tap to the food sheet. No row confidence/manual/provenance/verify text or reserved spacing.
- Remove Needs Review heading, duplicate review cards and its presentation call sites; no empty gap. Remove review-only row warning tint if it exists solely to solicit verification; normal journal styling remains.
- Individual food sheet exposes source/provenance, confidence and agent estimation notes in a compact secondary details area, preserving existing edit/correction/save behavior. No redundant verify button required if the sheet already edits the food.
- Preserve confidence/provenance/notes and needs-review data semantics in storage and MCP; do not mark items reviewed, increase confidence, delete data, or weaken uncertainty handling. Do not remove unrelated provenance labels such as goal source.
- Verify normal/low-confidence/missing-notes cases and actual full-row tap, save/cancel, accessibility, Paper/Night at phone size; regression proof must fail on old duplicated row/review UI and preserve sheet metadata.
- Coordinate overlapping TodayLogViews.swift changes with #223; no concurrent writers. Adjust affected row-target tests to preserve accessible food-sheet entry rather than retain retired buttons.
- Independent review PASS and CI green to staging; no automatic main promotion/TestFlight. #226 remains parked concept-only.

Refs #223 #198; focused surface simplification, not broad redesign.

**ROUTED for execution** — owner-approved UX refinement, queued through the normal safe impl→review→staging gate (mandate #198).

## Disposition

- **Slot:** the **next safe native slot AFTER #223**, because both lanes touch the same `TodayLogViews.swift` row surface (and #227's removal also touches `Views.swift`'s mount point). **One writer per surface — no concurrent writers.** #223 is the owner's stated priority, so it goes first; #227 follows and must re-base on the merged #223 head.
- **Base:** `origin/staging` at dispatch time (re-verify then).
- **Dependency on #223:** the AC explicitly says rows **retain illustration (coordinate #223)** — so this lane builds on #223's illustrated-row work, and must not undo it.

## Scope (remove row noise, keep the detail surface)

- `app/Sources/Morsel/TodayLogViews.swift` — `MealItemRow` must drop `ProvenanceLabel`, `ConfidenceBox` and `VerifyActionLabel` (no row confidence/manual/provenance/verify text and **no reserved spacing**); remove the **whole `NeedsReviewSection`** (heading, duplicate review cards) and any review-only warning tint that exists solely to solicit verification. Rows keep **illustration, name, portion, macros, kcal and a full-row accessible tap into the food sheet**.
- `app/Sources/Morsel/Views.swift` — remove the `NeedsReviewSection` mount/presentation call sites and leave **no empty gap**.
- `app/Sources/Morsel/MealItemEditSheet.swift` — **extend/reuse** the existing detail surface so an individual food sheet exposes **source/provenance, confidence and agent estimation notes** in a compact secondary details area, preserving the existing edit/correction/save behaviour. Do **not** create a second review workflow; no redundant verify button is required where the sheet already edits the food.
- Focused tests under `app/Tests/MorselTests/` (adjust affected row-target tests so they preserve the **accessible food-sheet entry** rather than asserting retired buttons) + `docs/evidence/issue-227-*`.

## Boundaries (data is not being changed)

Confidence/provenance/notes and needs-review **data semantics must be preserved in storage and MCP**: do not mark items reviewed, do not increase confidence, do not delete data, do not weaken uncertainty handling, and do not remove unrelated provenance labels (e.g. goal source). No server/schema/migration change, no per-log generation, no network dependency.

## Proof bar

Regression proof must **fail on the old duplicated row/review UI** and preserve the sheet metadata; cover **normal / low-confidence / missing-notes** cases plus **actual full-row tap**, **save/cancel**, **accessibility**, and **Paper/Night at phone size**. Source-string checks alone do not establish interaction.

**Boundaries:** review PASS + CI green → **staging only**. No automatic main promotion, release, deploy or TestFlight. **#226 remains parked concept-only** and is not resumed here.

This routing is a conductor decision, not a re-approval.

title: [iOS UX] Move confidence and provenance inside food sheets; remove Needs Review section
